name: Computer purchases
summary: Get guidance on university laptops, desktops and peripherals

details.title: Purchasing computers
details.html: York provides a supported computer purchase process for laptops, desktops and peripherals intended for University work. The available configurations and procurement route depend on the department and applicable purchasing policy

details.title: Quotes and delivery
details.html: The published catalogue notice states that pricing cannot currently be displayed because of market volatility and supply shortages. Request a quote and estimated delivery timeline from askIT rather than treating older prices as current

details.title: Account-protected purchasing detail
details.html: Some purchasing catalogue pages require Passport York sign-in. Those authenticated details are not reproduced here and must be incorporated only from an approved source once reviewed
